title: 1-2-Switch
fullContent:
Operating System: Other
															
							
															
																											
						
							1-2 Switch is a multiplayer party game that launched with the Nintendo Switch console. The game makes heavy use of the Switch’s Joy-Con motion controllers for its minigames, making it ideal for physiotherapy.

title: AMAneo Assistive Mouse Adapter
fullContent:
Operating System: Other
															
							
															
																											
						
							The AMAneo Anti-Tremor Assistive Mouse Adapter enables people with a hand tremor to use a computer mouse. It electronically filters the trembling of the hand, which can be very strong, so that the mouse pointer on the display moves smoothly. With tablets, touchscreen control is replaced by a normal mouse or an alternative mouse such as one offering head or chin control. Not all mice function within the power rating of the AMAneo USB so we now also include a free Logitech wireless mouse to ensure compatibility.
								   Additional Information: Manufacturer: CSS Microsystems (product page)
Support Document: https://www.csslabs.de/downloads/CSS_Produktuebersicht_AMAneo_DE_V10-21.pdf

title: Animated SandBox
fullContent:
Operating System: Other
															
							
															
																											
						
							The Animated Sandbox is an educational interactive experience in which users can change and redesign habitats and topography. Users will explore, create, and learn by using their imaginations and our augmented reality sandbox.
Users will pile up and dig out sand, while an interactive sensor detects the changes made to the sand and the projection adjusts accordingly in real time. Augmented reality layers will make mountains, plains, and bodies of water, teaching users about topography and different environments. Animals and objects will react to the changes and roam where they are found in their natural habitats. This interactive tabletop sandbox is perfect for schools, museums, science centers, and more!
								   Additional Information: Manufacturer: Breeze Creative LLC. (product page)

title: Assessment Switch Kit
fullContent:
Operating System: Other
															
							
															
																											
						
							The Assessment Switch Kit is a comprehensive, bespoke package designed for users with limited motor control, providing a diverse selection of highly sensitive switches that require zero to minimal pressure for activation. This kit allows educators, therapists, and caregivers to assess and determine the most suitable switch options for individual users, ensuring optimal accessibility and comfort.
								   Additional Information: Manufacturer: Inclusive Technology (product page)

fullContent:

							Mogo Super Evaluation Kit offers virtually every Mogo item to fully test different configurations to see what works best for wheelchair mounts and accessories. Featuring a sample of the three arms; modular metal, flexible steel, and modular plastic, plus a handful of bases and accessories.

title: TD Pilot
fullContent:
Operating System: iOS
															
							
															
																											
						
							TD Pilot is an eye-controlled communication device for iPad. Designed to empower people with conditions such as ALS/MND, spinal cord injury or cerebral palsy to communicate and use their favourite apps, this iPad OS-based speech generating device features the world’s leading eye tracker.
								   Additional Information: Manufacturer: Tobii Dynavox (https://www.tobiidynavox.com/pages/tdpilot)
Video:

title: Tobii PCEye 5
fullContent:
Operating System: Other
															
							
															
																											
						
							PCEye 5 is a compact eye tracker that enables people with physical disabilities to control a Windows computer with their eyes.
Replace a traditional keyboard and mouse with your eyes and surf the web, connect on social media, play games, create documents and more. Simply connect the PCEye to your Windows device via USB, and access everything your computer has to offer, intuitively and independently with TD Control.
								   Additional Information: Manufacturer: TobiiDynavox (https://www.tobiidynavox.com)
Support Manuals: https://www.tobiidynavox.com/pages/pceye-product-support

title: Xbox Adaptive Controller
fullContent:
Operating System: Windows
															
							
															
																											
						
							Xbox Adaptive Controller creates a custom controller experience that makes gaming more accessible. Connect external switches, buttons, mounts and joysticks.
Designed primarily to meet the needs of gamers with limited mobility, the Xbox Adaptive Controller features large programmable buttons and connects to external switches, buttons, mounts and joysticks to help make gaming more accessible. Requires external devices for gameplay.
								   Additional Information: Manufacturer: Xbox ( https://www.xbox.com/en-US/accessories/controllers/xbox-adaptive-controller)
